I Asked AI to Create These Things — The Results Were Interesting

What happens when AI creates images, videos, songs, websites, and more? Explore seven creative experiments and discover the tools you can try yourself.

By LokkeeVerse Editorial · 4 min read

I Asked AI to Create These Things — The Results Were Interesting

What happens when you ask AI to create a picture, write a song, design a website, or turn a simple idea into a video? The results can be surprisingly impressive, although not everything comes out perfectly on the first try.

I explored seven types of creative projects you can experiment with using AI tools in 2026. Here is what you can create and which websites are worth trying.

1. I Asked AI to Create a Realistic Image

Website: https://gemini.google.com/

AI image generators can turn a short description into detailed artwork, product concepts, portraits, and imaginary scenes.

For example, you could ask for a futuristic city at sunset with flying cars and realistic lighting. The result may look like a scene from a movie.

The interesting part is how much you can change by adjusting your prompt. Adding details about lighting, camera angles, colors, and atmosphere can make a noticeable difference.

2. I Asked AI to Turn Text Into a Video

Website: https://runwayml.com/

AI video generators can transform written descriptions or reference images into short video clips.

You could describe a sports car driving through a rainy city or a spaceship approaching an unknown planet. The tool generates a visual interpretation of your idea.

Results vary, and characters or objects may move unnaturally. Still, these tools can help creators produce visual concepts without filming every scene themselves.

3. I Asked AI to Create a Song

Website: https://suno.com/

AI music generators can create songs from text descriptions, including lyrics, musical styles, and moods.

You could request an upbeat Afrobeats-inspired track, a cinematic instrumental, or a relaxing song for background music.

The result may include vocals and instrumentation, depending on the tool and selected options. Always check the platform's current usage terms before using generated music commercially.

4. I Asked AI to Design a Website

Website: https://v0.app/

AI-assisted website builders can turn written instructions into interface concepts and code.

For example, you could request a modern landing page for a clothing brand, complete with product cards, navigation, and a contact section.

The generated design can provide a useful starting point, but you may still need to fix layouts, test mobile responsiveness, and connect working features.

5. I Asked AI to Create a Cartoon Character

Website: https://leonardo.ai/

AI image generators can help develop original character concepts for stories, games, animations, and social media content.

You might describe a friendly robot detective with glowing blue eyes and a futuristic jacket.

You can experiment with different outfits, backgrounds, and art styles. Keeping the same character consistent across multiple images may require reference images and repeated adjustments.

6. I Asked AI to Generate a Voiceover

Website: https://elevenlabs.io/

AI voice tools can turn written scripts into spoken narration.

This is useful for faceless YouTube videos, educational explainers, storytelling, and promotional content.

You can experiment with different voices and delivery styles, although pronunciation and emotional expression may need adjustment. Use voices responsibly and obtain permission when cloning or imitating someone's voice.

7. I Asked AI to Create a Logo

Website: https://www.recraft.ai/

AI design tools can help generate logo concepts, icons, and branding ideas from text prompts.

For example, you could describe a minimalist logo for a technology company using geometric shapes and a blue color palette.

The first result may not be ready for professional use, but it can give you several creative directions to explore. Check the design carefully and verify commercial-use rights before adopting it as your brand identity.

Which AI Creation Was Most Useful?

Each tool serves a different purpose:

  • Images: Gemini or Leonardo AI.
  • Videos: Runway.
  • Music: Suno.
  • Website concepts: v0.
  • Cartoon characters: Leonardo AI.
  • Voiceovers: ElevenLabs.
  • Logo concepts: Recraft.

Some tools offer free access, while others use credits, subscriptions, or feature restrictions. Check their current plans before starting.

Final Thoughts

AI can turn ordinary instructions into images, videos, music, voices, and design concepts. The results can be impressive, but the best output often comes from experimenting with prompts and refining what the tool creates.

Choose one idea, try a suitable tool, and see how far you can take it. You might discover a new way to create content, develop a business idea, or bring a project to life.
